blocking_focus: Complete the candidate-bound Tester MCP state matrix.

task_specification.objective: Deliver three bounded release-convergence implementation surfaces: restore spatial readability and complete-run lifecycle, replace text-stacked choices with an authored accessible hierarchy while satisfying animation/VFX/lighting/audio presentation, and harden dense-wave performance across retries. Preserve the native Godot project, authored cemetery package, deterministic combat, and retained weapon/build mechanisms.

diagnosis.root_cause: The active release-convergence defect is an authored-arena framing/integration problem: the shipped high-angle camera allows the central landmark and its collision owners to occlude the Warden and nearby enemies. The phase also still needs explicit complete-run release behavior, dense-run performance qualification, and a player-facing HUD/choice hierarchy.

stop_conditions: Do not assign or modify deferred issue findings in this loop.
Do not replace preserved authored assets or add backlog-only scope.
Stop when the three implementation families have direct black-box and white-box retest predicates; Runtime and Tester own recapture, verdicts, and phase closure.

strategy.rationale: Use the mandated ordinary spatial/lifecycle, HUD presentation, and dense-performance families. Treat camera occlusion through explicit occluder-instance restoration and camera-aware visibility composition rather than another transform-only tweak. Make the required choice capability concrete and player-facing by explicitly replacing text-stacked weapon/upgrade choices.

code: Run native Godot project and host boot checks; verify no parse/runtime errors in touched files.
Exercise upgrade choices through keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus and assert one debounced authoritative transaction with truthful deltas and distinct weapon behavior.
Run the deterministic dense checkpoint at 1920x1080 and inspect frame-time/count/high-water receipts across three retries.
Run complete failure and victory routes through Result, Credits & Notices/provenance, and Retry; verify a clean authoritative restart.
runtime: Runtime/Tester must recapture spawn, critical-route, cardinal/landmark, and ordinary movement replay states, including before-contact, near-contact, and after-departure around the central building/landmark; inspect external depth, collision, boundary/perimeter, and disappearance/occlusion.

Runtime/Tester must collect HUD page/focus predicates, upgrade mutation receipts, active animation/VFX/lighting/audio state, dense counters/logs, wave/boss terminal states, and Result→Retry reset receipts.
Formal phase verdicts and active issue closure remain host/Tester responsibilities; deferred findings receive no current-loop disposition.
visual: Capture shipped gameplay frames at spawn, critical route, cardinal/landmark, and ordinary movement replay; verify readable Warden, enemies, escape lane, central building/landmark, external world depth, and perimeter without disappearance or occlusion drift.

Capture upgrade cards in keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus states; verify replacement of text-stacked choices, silhouette/icon hierarchy, restrained copy, truthful changed deltas, and bespoke Mournlight presentation.
Capture dense final-wave/boss combat and failure/victory Result→Retry frames at 1920x1080; verify readable telegraphs, bounded effects/lighting/audio, no placeholders, and clean restart visuals.

done_when: The shipped high-angle camera keeps the Warden, nearby enemies, central building/landmark, and at least one escape lane substantially visible during spawn, approach, contact, departure, and ordinary movement replay; no disappearance or occlusion drift occurs.

The arena has expand or larger traversable scale, coherent external world or external depth, aligned collision, and a stable boundary/perimeter. Ordinary movement cannot pass through the central building/landmark, and cardinal/critical-route views remain stable.

A complete seven-to-ten-minute route supports failure and victory branches, Result statistics/build summary, Credits & Notices/provenance presentation, and Retry into a fresh authoritative run with no stale actors, timers, signals, pools, pause reasons, attacks, effects, audio, HUD, or upgrade state.
Focused bolts, close sweeps, and orbiting area control are each qualified only from distinct successful ordinary routes and retain distinct visible attack patterns after restart.
Tester can repeat landmark movement replay and Result→Retry with spatial bounds/collision probes, camera coverage, and lifecycle reset receipts.
tasks.instructions: Repair the ordinary release surface around finding.camera_occlusion using explicit authored-instance restoration, corrected landmark collision/visual pairing, sight-lane or visibility-layer isolation, and camera-aware composition rather than another transform-only tweak. Keep the intact authored cemetery package authoritative and keep the camera within its footprint. Ensure expand or larger traversable scale with coherent external world/external depth, central building/landmark collision, stable boundary/perimeter, and ordinary movement replay without disappearance or occlusion. Complete the authoritative run controller, result ledger, credits/provenance presentation, and Retry reset so failure and victory both return to a clean playable baseline. Preserve deterministic targeting, exactly-once combat receipts, and the three weapon identities.
tasks.title: Restore arena spatial integrity and complete-run release

done_when: Replace text-stacked weapon and upgrade choices with authored visual hierarchy: each choice leads with a recognizable silhouette/icon, compact stat icons, restrained copy, and truthful current-to-new values.
Each choice shows no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas; CURRENT never contains NEW or LOCKED placeholders, and unchanged, zero-placeholder, unrelated, or exhaustive rows are omitted.

Keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus, hover, pressed, unavailable, and selected states are visibly distinct without changing card dimensions; held confirmation is debounced and exactly one authoritative upgrade transaction commits before gameplay resumes.
The normal HUD keeps health, experience/level, wave/run progress, equipped weapons/ranks, dash readiness, and contextual boss health readable over the arena at supported scales.

Active animation states, moonlight/lantern hierarchy, causal bounded VFX, and semantic audio presentation remain coherent at gameplay density without fallback clips, leaked loops, hum, unexpected speech, generic tones, or effects that hide telegraphs.
Tester can inspect HUD page/focus predicates, current-to-new values, authoritative build mutation, and presentation-state receipts in the same session.
tasks.instructions: Replace text-stacked weapon and upgrade choices with an authored Mournlight hierarchy built around silhouettes/icons, compact stat icons, restrained consequence copy, and truthful current-to-new deltas capped at three. Exclude ineligible or unchanged fields, never render NEW or LOCKED as CURRENT, and implement complete keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus/activation states with held-confirm debounce. Preserve the compact transparent gameplay HUD and bespoke lantern-glass, moon-silver, carved-stone, and brass language. Audit active animation, VFX, lighting, and semantic audio presentation for bounded readable cues and no generic or leaked fallback presentation, while leaving deferred issue disposition to a later matching evidence pass. Expose stable UI and build-state predicates for Tester.
tasks.title: Author truthful accessible choices and presentation

done_when: At 1920x1080 representative final-wave density, frame-time distribution and movement/combat responsiveness remain stable with 25–40 ordinary enemies plus all weapon families, pickups, animation, VFX, lights, UI, and audio.

Enemy, projectile, pickup, XP, impact/VFX, floating-label, light, and transient-audio lifecycles are pooled, staggered, or otherwise bounded; live and high-water counts do not grow across three complete retries.
Wave/director/boss progression remains deterministic and readable, spawn safety keeps threats off the player, collision, and outside the arena, and spawning stops after failure, victory, or result.
A release-safe deterministic stress checkpoint exposes frame-time distribution, entity counts, pool reuse/retirement, and runtime-error guards without replacing gameplay with telemetry.
Tester can compare dense checkpoint snapshots and logs across three retries while preserving native project and host boot baselines.
tasks.instructions: Harden the real dense-run path at 1920x1080, including the Bellkeeper final wave, 25–40 ordinary enemies, all weapon families, pickups, animation, VFX, lights, UI, and audio. Add bounded cleanup/reuse and staggered work for enemies, attacks/projectiles, pickups/XP, impacts, labels, lights, and transient audio while preserving deterministic wave composition, elite/boss telegraphs, recoverable escape lanes, spawn validation, and terminal stop. Expose a deterministic tester stress checkpoint with frame-time distribution, live/high-water counts, pool reuse/retirement, and runtime-error guards; keep it release-safe and subordinate to actual gameplay. Ensure three complete retries return to the same bounded baseline and remain compatible with spatial, HUD, build, and Result/Retry work.
tasks.title: Bound dense-wave performance and lifecycle
